title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
provenance: Reported by mohsin17-sys (highball-db#878, 2026-11-01), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.24, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, D3DMetal, rated 4 of 5 after 125 minutes: with AVX advertised, D3DM_MTL4=1, D3DM_SUPPORT_DXR=1 and a frame cap of 120. Not verified by the maintainer. callnegi09 (highball-db#1074, 2026-11-08, the same report also posted as highball-db#1073): rated 5 of 5, chip given as M5 and macOS as latest, with no engine, graphics mode or session stated. mohsin17-sys (highball-db#1116, 2026-11-09), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.25, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, D3DMetal, rated 5 of 5 after 52 minutes: with AVX advertised, D3DM_MTL4=1, D3DM_SUPPORT_DXR=1 and Retina pixels at 100%, in an environment with the EA app recipe and no Steam. namanag210-commits (highball-db#1133, 2026-11-10), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.25, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, D3DMetal, rated 4 of 5 after 55 minutes: with AVX advertised and Windows 11 as the Windows version. The sound glitches at times. The reporter says to use MacGameFix for the T-pose issue.
notes: Reported playable on an M4 Pro with D3DMetal over two hours, with AVX advertised, D3DM_MTL4=1 and D3DM_SUPPORT_DXR=1 set by the player. A player on an M4 Pro rates it playable with the sound glitching at times, and uses MacGameFix for characters stuck in a T-pose (highball-db#1133).

knownIssues.symptom: Characters stuck in a T-pose (reported on an M4 Pro, D3DMetal, Wine 10 r29)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed here. MacGameFix's readme lists this game with a T-pose, a broken symbiote and black blocks in the sandstorm on D3DMetal, and says its fix rebuilds four of the game's shaders
knownIssues.fix: the reporter uses MacGameFix (github.com/MathiasKowoll/MacGameFix), a third party app that installs fixes into a game's folder (highball-db#1133). Its readme names CrossOver and Steam Play tools, not Highball. Untested here

knownIssues.symptom: The sound glitches at times (reported on an M4 Pro, D3DMetal, Wine 10 r29)
